name: How do I choose the right contractor for fiber cement siding replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for fiber cement siding replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for one with extensive experience specifically in fiber cement siding installation, like City Dweller, LLC. Verify their licensing, insurance, and ask for references or a portfolio of previous work. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining all costs and project timelines. A reputable contractor will also be transparent about warranties and adhere to local building codes, ensuring a high-quality and compliant installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with fiber cement experience, verify licensing and insurance, check references, and ensure a detailed estimate and warranty.
